source_evidence.quote: Preserve all six original full6km bookings and complete future return transport, not just a ride to the trailhead. Check the entire route, certified chair bay, ordinary seats, continuous escort cover and full empty repositioning journeys. Make actual transport and subgroup booking receiving, correct old public guidance, repair independent guide/map and driver/itinerary, give both parties complete own usable packs and execute selected staff expense without changing participant prices. No walk or drive has happened during this planning commission.

Invented chair requirement:every used segment width at least1.1m,gradient at most6%,no steps,and current open. Original Ridge6km:GateA apron1.4m/2%,Pine1.2m/4%,BridgeB1.2m/3%,Hillsteps0.9m/9% and6steps. Lower6km GateC full circuit:Canal1.3m/3%,Meadow1.2m/5%,Southramp1.4m/4%,all step-free. GateC has level Canal entrance and staffed shelter; inspect report20 for current Southramp status. A level GateA apron is not a whole-route finding.
Southramp current status awaits report20; measurements alone do not establish open status.

Pair booking:Iris uses one certified wheelchair bay, no transfer to ordinary seat accepted;Jo must remain in the same van as companion. Paid24 tokenI-120 own accountI-200 for two full6km places. Walk booking:Kai,Luz,Mina,Noor four ordinary seated travellers,paid48 tokenW-480 own accountW-400 for four full6km places. Qualified escort Eva must remain with Kai continuously from Kai first loading through return arrival at base. Eva occupies one ordinary seat and is not one of the six paid participants. Driver Dan occupies the separate driving seat and is not qualified to substitute for Eva. At GateC a staffed waiting shelter opens150; early arrivals may wait there, but Kai still needs Eva. No other escort or vehicle is available.
Southramp open,1.4m/4%,step-free;Canal and Meadow open. Lower full6km GateC all current open. Ridge Hillsteps still fails supplied limits.
